trap.label: falso cognato (resumo)
trap.why: Pretender e assistir parecem equivalentes, mas são falsos cognatos: pretend = fingir; assist = ajudar. Para resenhas, use claim/aim to e watch/see.

fix.wrong: This novel follow a young chef.
fix.right: This novel follows a young chef.

rewrite.prompt: Reescreva com would: “I recommend this book.”
Reescreva com 3ª pessoa: “The novel follow a girl.”
Reescreva: “I recommend it to you.” → “I would ...”
rewrite.answer: I would recommend it to you.
